title: Prannoy Hints 2026 Asian Games May Be His Last, Eyes LA 2028 Olympics
indian_angle: India's top male shuttler HS Prannoy discusses his future participation in major multi-sport events, including the upcoming Asian Games and potential 2028 Olympics.
summary: HS Prannoy suggests the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games could be his last major outing but leaves the door open for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics if he remains competitive.

title: Indian Shuttlers Face Tough Japan Challenge in Asian Games Quarterfinals
indian_angle: The draws for the Asian Games badminton team events reveal that both Indian men's and women's teams are projected to meet strong Japanese opponents in the quarterfinals.
summary: The Asian Games badminton draws indicate a challenging path for Indian men's and women's teams, with potential quarterfinal clashes against host nation Japan.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India is conducting an advanced Level-1 coaches course across two National Centers of Excellence, investing in future Indian badminton talent development.
summary: The BAI is running an advanced Level-1 coaches course from September 14-23 at NCE Guwahati and Raipur, aiming to enhance coaching standards in India.

title: BAI Adopts New 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has introduced a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
summary: A new 3x15 scoring system has been implemented by BAI for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories.

title: Indian Junior Shuttlers Qualify for World Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: The list of eligible players and those qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo has been released, paving the way for India's next generation.
summary: BAI has announced the eligibility criteria and qualified players for the final selection trials for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.
